summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I'd do (audit, in order):** 1. Read the full chain again live, not just statically: `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` auth middleware → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` (`user_id` scoping) → `db/auth.ts` session/login logic → `server.ts` mount order. 2. Reproduce the bug manually: sign in, add cards, log out, log back in (same browser, then a second browser/incognito to simulate "different device"), and watch the actual network requests/cookies/response bodies �
